annotations.title: Make character dance or do a trend

description: Make a saved Character Studio character perform: a dance, a trend or a star moment (AI Dance, Sassy Dance, Shoulder Shimmy, Hair Flip, Catwalk, Peace Wink, Red Carpet, Award Win...) as a share-ready 5 s video. action "list" (free) gives the presets and prices; action "run" takes character (name or @Name) and preset. Usually handed off; poll with pixeldojo_status.

action.description: list = presets with prices (free). run = make the video (paid).

character.description: run: the saved character's name or @Name (pixeldojo_library source=characters lists them).

preset.description: run: a preset slug from action "list", e.g. "ai-dance", "shoulder-shimmy", "red-carpet".

name: pixeldojo_perform
title: Make character dance or do a trend
